stars_field: Annual scope 1 GHG emissions
rationale: STARS reports total annual scope 1 in metric tons CO2e; GRI 305-1 requires gross direct (Scope 1) GHG emissions in metric tons CO2e.
caveat: GRI 305-1 additionally requires biogenic CO2 to be reported separately from the gross figure.

stars_field: Scope 1 GHG emissions from stationary combustion
rationale: A constituent of the scope 1 total that GRI 305-1 reports as one gross figure.

stars_field: Scope 1 GHG emissions from mobile combustion
rationale: A constituent of the scope 1 total that GRI 305-1 reports as one gross figure.

stars_field: Scope 1 GHG fugitive emissions
rationale: A constituent of the scope 1 total that GRI 305-1 reports as one gross figure.

stars_field: Scope 1 GHG process emissions
rationale: A constituent of the scope 1 total that GRI 305-1 reports as one gross figure.

stars_field: GHG emissions from biogenic sources
rationale: GRI 305-1 requires biogenic CO2 emissions to be stated separately from gross scope 1.
caveat: GRI asks for biogenic CO2 specifically; the STARS field is CO2-equivalent and may not be the same boundary.

stars_field: Annual scope 2 GHG emissions
rationale: STARS scope 2 total corresponds to GRI 305-2 energy indirect emissions.
caveat: GRI 305-2 requires location-based and, where available, market-based figures reported separately. Do not present a single scope 2 number without saying which method.

stars_field: Scope 2 GHG emissions from off-site sources of electricity (market-based)
rationale: Market-based scope 2 electricity, one of the two methods GRI 305-2 requires.

stars_field: Scope 2 GHG emissions from off-site sources of electricity (location-based)
rationale: Location-based scope 2 electricity, one of the two methods GRI 305-2 requires.

stars_field: Scope 2 GHG emissions from off-site sources of heating and cooling
rationale: Purchased heating/cooling is within the GRI 305-2 scope 2 boundary.

stars_field: Scope 3 GHG emissions from business travel
rationale: A GHG Protocol scope 3 category; GRI 305-3 requires the categories included to be listed.

stars_field: Scope 3 GHG emissions from commuting
rationale: A GHG Protocol scope 3 category; GRI 305-3 requires the categories included to be listed.

stars_field: Scope 3 GHG emissions from purchased goods and services
rationale: A GHG Protocol scope 3 category; GRI 305-3 requires the categories included to be listed.

stars_field: Scope 3 GHG emissions from capital goods
rationale: A GHG Protocol scope 3 category; GRI 305-3 requires the categories included to be listed.

stars_field: Scope 3 GHG emissions from waste generated in operations
rationale: A GHG Protocol scope 3 category; GRI 305-3 requires the categories included to be listed.

stars_field: Scope 3 GHG emissions from fuel- and energy-related activities not included in scope 1 or scope 2
rationale: A GHG Protocol scope 3 category; GRI 305-3 requires the categories included to be listed.

stars_field: Annual scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions per person
rationale: GRI 305-4 is a ratio of absolute emissions to an organization-specific denominator.
caveat: GRI 305-4 requires the denominator to be stated. Here it is FTE students + employees, not a corporate revenue or output metric.

stars_field: Annual scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions per unit of floor area
rationale: GRI 305-4 is a ratio of absolute emissions to an organization-specific denominator.
caveat: Denominator is gross floor area in square meters; must be disclosed alongside the ratio.

stars_field: Percentage reduction in scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions from baseline
rationale: Both concern reduction against a baseline.
caveat: GRI 305-5 asks for reductions as an ABSOLUTE quantity in metric tons CO2e; STARS gives a percentage. Not directly substitutable - derive the absolute figure from the baseline and current fields.

stars_field: Total annual energy consumption
rationale: STARS total annual energy consumption corresponds to GRI 302-1 energy consumption within the organization.
caveat: GRI 302-1 expects joules or multiples and requires fuel consumption split into renewable and non-renewable. STARS reports megawatt-hours - convertible, but state the conversion.

stars_field: Total electricity consumption
rationale: Electricity consumption is an explicit component of GRI 302-1.

stars_field: Total stationary fuel consumption
rationale: Fuel consumption is an explicit component of GRI 302-1.

stars_field: Annual renewable energy consumption
rationale: GRI 302-1 requires the renewable/non-renewable split; this field supplies the renewable side.

stars_field: Annual energy consumption per person
rationale: GRI 302-3 is an energy intensity ratio against an organization-specific denominator.
caveat: Denominator (FTE students + employees) must be disclosed with the ratio.

stars_field: Annual energy consumption per unit of floor area
rationale: GRI 302-3 is an energy intensity ratio against an organization-specific denominator.
caveat: Denominator is gross floor area; must be disclosed with the ratio.

stars_field: Total water withdrawal
rationale: STARS total water withdrawal matches the GRI 303-3 concept of total water withdrawal.
caveat: GRI 303-3 requires a breakdown by source AND a separate figure for areas with water stress. STARS collects neither, so 303-3 cannot be fully satisfied from STARS alone.

stars_field: Potable water from off-site sources
rationale: Third-party water is a GRI 303-3 withdrawal source category.

stars_field: Potable water from on-site sources
rationale: On-site abstraction is a GRI 303-3 withdrawal source category.

stars_field: Annual potable water use
rationale: Both describe water consumed by the organization.
caveat: DEFINITIONS DIFFER. GRI 303-5 water consumption = withdrawal minus discharge. STARS 'annual potable water use' is potable supply only and is not computed that way. Do not present this as GRI 303-5 without recomputing.

stars_field: Annual volume of water recovered and/or returned
rationale: Water returned to the environment is conceptually adjacent to GRI 303-4 water discharge.
caveat: GRI 303-4 requires discharge by destination, freshwater/other water split, and treatment level. STARS captures none of that. Weak mapping - verify before use.

stars_field: Annual non-hazardous waste generated
rationale: STARS annual waste generated corresponds to GRI 306-3 waste generated, in metric tons.
caveat: GRI 306-3 covers TOTAL waste including hazardous, broken down by composition. STARS reports non-hazardous separately and does not collect hazardous waste tonnage.

stars_field: Annual construction and demolition waste generated
rationale: C&D waste is part of total waste generated under GRI 306-3.

stars_field: Total non-hazardous waste diverted from disposal
rationale: STARS diversion from disposal matches the GRI 306-4 concept directly.
caveat: GRI 306-4 requires a split by recovery operation (reuse / recycling / other) and by on-site vs off-site.

stars_field: Non-hazardous waste recycled
rationale: Recycling is a named GRI 306-4 recovery operation.

stars_field: Non-hazardous waste composted
rationale: Composting falls under GRI 306-4 other recovery operations.

stars_field: Non-hazardous waste prepared for reuse
rationale: Preparation for reuse is a named GRI 306-4 recovery operation.

stars_field: Total construction and demolition waste diverted from disposal
rationale: C&D diversion contributes to GRI 306-4 waste diverted from disposal.

stars_field: Construction and demolition waste recycled
rationale: Recycling is a named GRI 306-4 recovery operation.

stars_field: Non-hazardous waste disposed of to a landfill or incinerator
rationale: Landfill and incineration are the GRI 306-5 disposal operations.
caveat: GRI 306-5 requires the split between incineration with and without energy recovery. STARS has a partial signal in the waste-to-energy percentage field.

stars_field: Construction and demolition waste disposed of to a landfill or incinerator
rationale: C&D disposal contributes to GRI 306-5 waste directed to disposal.

stars_field: Percentage of employees that receive remuneration equivalent to at least a living wage
rationale: Both concern wage floors relative to an external benchmark.
caveat: BENCHMARKS DIFFER. GRI 202-1 compares entry-level wage to the local MINIMUM wage, by gender. STARS compares to a LIVING wage and has no gender split. Not interchangeable - report as a university-sector variant and say so.

stars_field: Living wage
rationale: The living-wage threshold underpinning the STARS pay-floor indicators.
caveat: See caveat on the percentage field: GRI's benchmark is the local minimum wage, not a living wage.

rationale: STARS PA-7 reports racial and ethnic representation of the campus population.
caveat: GRI 405-1 asks for diversity of GOVERNANCE BODIES and of employees by category. STARS PA-7 covers students and staff without the governance-body breakdown GRI requires.

rationale: STARS PA-8 reports gender representation of the campus population.
caveat: Same limitation as PA-7: no governance-body-level breakdown, and students are included in a way GRI 405-1 does not contemplate.

rationale: GRI requires emissions of ozone-depleting substances.
caveat: STARS 3.0 collects no ODS data at any credit. Cannot be reported from this dataset.

rationale: GRI requires NOx, SOx and other significant air emissions.
caveat: STARS 3.0 collects no criteria-air-pollutant data. Cannot be reported from this dataset.

rationale: GRI requires work-related injury rates and counts.
caveat: PA-11 (Health, Safety and Wellbeing) contains no injury figures - its only numeric fields are STARS scoring artefacts. Cannot be reported.

rationale: GRI requires work-related ill health data.
caveat: PA-11 contains no ill-health figures. Cannot be reported.

rationale: GRI requires new employee hires and turnover.
caveat: STARS 3.0 collects no hiring or turnover figures.

rationale: GRI requires the ratio of basic salary and remuneration of women to men.
caveat: PA-13 covers living-wage coverage and wage floors but not a gender pay ratio. Despite the credit being named 'Pay Equity', the GRI pay-equity disclosure cannot be satisfied.

rationale: GRI asks for the proportion of senior management hired locally.
caveat: No STARS credit collects this.

rationale: GRI asks for the annual total compensation ratio.
caveat: STARS collects wage floors but not the highest-paid-to-median ratio GRI defines.

rationale: STARS AC-1 counts sustainability course offerings.
caveat: GRI has no disclosure for teaching. This is a higher-education-specific impact with no corporate analogue - a finding, not a defect.

rationale: STARS AC-6 counts sustainability research activity.
caveat: GRI has no disclosure for research output. No corporate analogue.

rationale: STARS EN-1 covers sustainability outreach and communications to the campus community.
caveat: Partially adjacent to GRI 2-29 stakeholder engagement, but GRI frames stakeholders as external parties affected by impacts, not students being educated. Left unmapped pending review.
